headline: Approved February financial items, new members, retirements, budget, and conference attendance.
summary: The board accepted February meeting minutes, financial warrants, new member enrollments, retirement applications, and withdrawals/transfers, all by unanimous vote of those present. It also approved the 2026 budget with a postage budget change to $8000.00, approved the 2026 budget with allowance for additional costs, and approved staff and board attendance at 2026 conferences and an educational seminar.
decisions: Approved February Board Meeting Minutes and Executive Session Minutes, March Expense Warrant, February Retiree Payroll and Staff Payroll Warrant, Cash Book & Cash Reconciliations; all present in favor.
Approved new members Joanna Mayo, Angela Vozzella, Coleen Murphy, and Karen Pino; all present in favor.
Approved Retirement Applications, Adjustments, and Survivor Benefits for Rebecca Smith, Richard Moore, and Caroline Jacques; all present in favor.
Approved Retirement Withdrawals and Transfers for Romario Berneche, Amanda Y Rodriguez Tabares, Zinah Hammadi, and Sherline Gustave; all present in favor.
Approved the waiver form for a pre-employment physical for new members; all present in favor.
Approved the 2026 Budget proposal with the postage budget changed to $8000.00; all present in favor.
Approved the 2026 Budget as presented with allowance to adjust for additional costs; all present in favor.
Approved attendance for the 2026 MACRS and NCPERS Conferences and an additional 2-day Educational Seminar for Board members and staff; all present in favor.

# BOARD MEETING MINUTES

DATE: March 11, 2026

A meeting of the Malden Retirement Board was held this day March 11, 2026, at 8:46 AM in conference room #105 at Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant St. Malden, MA with the following present: Warren Atkinson Jr., Domenic Fermano (Absent), John Hall, Scott Lucey, Charles Ranaghan. Staff: Director, Robert Soohoo, and Board Secretary Maria LoGrasso.

### Call to Order

The Chairman, Mr. Atkinson Jr. called the meeting to order at 8:46 AM. The Board Secretary Maria LoGrasso took an attendance roll call vote.

Roll Call:

- Mr. Atkinson Jr. - Yes
- Mr. Fermano - Absent
- Mr. Hall - Yes
- Mr. Lucey - Yes
- Mr. Ranaghan - Yes

### General Meeting

**Accept February Board Meeting Minutes and Executive Session Minutes, March Expense Warrant, February Retiree Payroll and Staff Payroll Warrant, Cash Book & Cash Reconciliations.**

**VOTE:** To accept February Board Meeting Minutes and Executive Session Minutes, March Expense Warrant, February Retiree Payroll and Staff Payroll Warrant, Cash Book & Cash Reconciliations. Motion by Mr. Hall and seconded by Mr. Ranaghan, it was voted:

*All present were in favor

### New Members

- Joanna Mayo - MPS, Assistant Cook, Hire Date 03/09/2026
- Angela Vozzella - MPS, ESP, Hire Date 03/02/2026
- Coleen Murphy - MPS, ESP, Hire Date 03/02/2026
- Karen Pino - Police, Clerk/Assistant to the Prosecutor, Hire Date 03/02/2026

**VOTE:** To accept new members. Motion by Mr. Ranaghan and seconded by Mr. Hall, it was voted:

*All present were in favor

### Deceased

Joseph G. Bates - Fire, Date of Death 03/01/2026, Option C (Phyllis Bates)

### Retirement Applications, Adjustments, and Survivor Benefits

- Rebecca Smith, Library. Date of Retirement: 03/28/2026 Option A
- Richard Moore, Public Facilities, Date of Retirement: 03/06/2026 Option C
- Caroline Jacques, MPS, Paraprofessional, Date of Retirement: 02/28/2026 Option A

**VOTE:** To accept Retirement Applications, Adjustments, and Survivor Benefits. Motion by Mr. Lucey and seconded by Mr. Ranaghan, it was voted:

*All present were in favor

### Withdrawals/Transfers

- Romario Berneche - MPS, Paraprofessional, 5 years, Transfer to Salem
- Amanda Y Rodriguez Tabares - MPS, 1 year, 4 months, Transfer to MTRS
- Zinah Hammadi - MPS, Paraprofessional, 2 years, 3 months, Transfer to Medford
- Sherline Gustave - Police, Cadet, 1 year, 10 months, Refund

**VOTE:** To accept Retirement Withdrawals and Transfers. Motion by Mr. Ranaghan and seconded by Mr. Lucey, it was voted:

*All present were in favor

### Buybacks, Makeups and Military Purchases

### Correspondence - Recent PERAC Memos

- #11 - Disability Presumptions and Pre-Employment Physicals

**VOTE:** To accept the waiver form for a pre-employment physical for new members. Motion by Mr. Lucey and seconded by Mr. Hall, it was voted:

*All present were in favor

- #12 - Violent Act Injury Disability Updated Forms

### Director Report

COLA Notice Memo - The Retirement Board will resend the COLA Notice with the 30-day threshold to the mayor and council and revote at the April 15, 2026 Board meeting.

### Review of 2025 Budget

**VOTE:** To approve the 2026 Budget proposal with the change to the postage budget to $8000.00. Motion by Mr. Lucey and seconded by Mr. Ranaghan, it was voted:

*All present were in favor

### Discussion of 2026 Budget

**VOTE:** To approve the 2026 Budget as presented with the allowance to adjust for additional costs. Motion by Mr. Ranaghan and seconded by Mr. Hall, it was voted:

*All present were in favor

### Review of Robert Soohoo Timesheet

The Board acknowledged the Director will pay back the vacation and sick time payout he received in January and will get all of the vacation and sick time back.

### Review of 2026 Conferences and Educational Seminars

**VOTE:** To approve attendance for the 2026 MACRS and NCPERS Conferences and additional 2-day Educational Seminar for Board members and staff. Motion by Mr. Ranaghan and seconded by Mr. Hall, it was voted:

*All present were in favor

### Review of Frederick Wilson's ADR

The Board was notified of Mr. Wilson request of second medical panel by his attorney.

**VOTE:** To adjourn the meeting 10:02 AM Eastern time, Motion by Mr. Hall, seconded by Mr. Lucey, it was voted:

*All present were in favor
